name: capture.file
description: A new file for the caller's own capture: the copy of the shared reel or post, in the type Meta served it. Answers a signed write URL and the file's stable address. Internal: packages/connect copies the media, as the person the sender is linked to.
sql: update brandbase.captures c set file_key = :file where c.id = :id and c.user_id = brandbase.caller() returning jsonb_build_object('upload', jsonb_build_object('key', c.file_key, 'type', :mime::text)) as result
